label: Viking Berserker
description: a fierce Viking berserker: muscular, braided blonde hair and full blonde beard, dark leather-and-fur armour with one large spiked steel pauldron, crossed leather straps with a bear-head belt buckle, leather bracers, brown trousers, fur-trimmed leather boots, wielding a large two-handed double-headed rune-etched battle-axe with faint yellow electric sparks crackling along the blades

portrait.prompt: Using the attached character reference exactly (same character: {description}), draw a square character-select portrait in the same pixel-art style: chest-up close-up, the face large and fierce, mouth open in a battle roar, the head turned three-quarters toward the left, the upper part of the axe head visible over the far shoulder with sparks crackling, dramatic rim lighting. Solid dark stormy blue-purple background with a subtle pixel texture, no other characters, no text, no logo, no watermark, no frame.

actions.label: Idle
actions.note: The feet stay planted in exactly the same place in every frame; only the upper body, arms, axe, hair and sparks move.
poses: rest pose, chest neutral, both knees slightly bent, axe held level across the body, braid hanging still, faint sparks on the blade
inhale begins, chest and shoulders rise about 2 pixels, axe head lifts slightly, braid starts to swing forward
inhale continues, shoulders raised about 4 pixels, chest expanded, knees straighten a little, axe head tilts up slightly, sparks brighter
peak of the breath, chest at its highest, head raised slightly, axe head at its highest point, braid swung furthest forward, sparks at their brightest
exhale begins, shoulders drop about 2 pixels, axe head starts to lower, braid swings back
exhale continues, chest lowers, knees bend a little deeper, axe head dips below level, sparks dim
lowest point, torso about 3 pixels lower than the rest pose, knees most bent, axe head lowest, braid swung furthest back, sparks faint
recovery, torso rising back toward the rest pose, very close to frame 1 so the loop is seamless, axe head returning to level

actions.label: Walk Forward
actions.note: A heavy, stomping walk cycle moving toward the LEFT. The character stays centred in its cell (walking in place); only the legs, torso bob and axe move. The axe stays held across the body in both hands.
poses: contact: the left (front) foot heel planted far ahead, the right (back) foot toe still on the ground behind, torso upright
down: weight sinks onto the front foot, knees bend, torso dips about 3 pixels, the back foot lifts off the ground
passing: the back leg swings forward past the planted leg, body at mid height, axe head bobs up slightly
up: body at its highest point, the swinging leg reaching forward, weight rising over the planted leg
contact, opposite leg: the other foot heel planted far ahead, the first foot toe on the ground behind (mirror of frame 1)
down, opposite leg: weight sinks onto the new front foot, torso dips about 3 pixels (mirror of frame 2)
passing, opposite leg: the back leg swings forward past the planted leg, axe head bobs up (mirror of frame 3)
up, opposite leg: body at its highest point, leading smoothly back into frame 1 (mirror of frame 4)

actions.label: Walk Backward
actions.note: A cautious retreating shuffle: the character keeps FACING LEFT toward the enemy, guard up, but steps backward (moving to the right) with short steps. The character stays centred in its cell (walking in place); only the legs, torso bob and axe move.
poses: contact: the right (back) foot toe placed behind, the left foot flat in front, torso leaning very slightly back, axe held guard-level
down: weight shifts onto the back foot, knees bend slightly, torso dips about 2 pixels
passing: the front (left) foot slides back past the other foot, body at mid height
contact, opposite leg: the left foot toe placed behind, the right foot flat in front (mirror of frame 1)
down, opposite leg: weight shifts onto the back foot, torso dips about 2 pixels (mirror of frame 2)
passing, opposite leg: the front (right) foot slides back past the other foot, leading smoothly into frame 1

actions.label: Crouch
actions.note: The four frames show four clearly DIFFERENT poses going from standing down to kneeling; the feet stay on the same ground line.
poses: standing guard stance exactly as in the reference, full height
half squat: knees bent forward, hips pushed back and down, torso leaning forward, the head clearly lower than in frame 1
dropping to one knee: the back (right) knee almost touching the ground, the front foot planted, axe lowered in front

kneeling on the right knee with the left foot planted in front, torso upright and compact, axe held horizontally across the chest, head still looking left; the whole body is only about 60 percent as tall as in frame 1

actions.label: Jump
actions.note: The ground line is at the same height in every frame. Frames 1 and 6 have the feet on the ground line; in frames 3, 4 and 5 the whole character is drawn clearly above the ground line (feet about a quarter of the body height above it). Keep the character horizontally centred in its cell.
poses: anticipation: deep crouch, knees very bent, torso low, axe pulled back, feet on the ground line
launch: legs extending, body stretched upward, feet just leaving the ground line
rising: whole body above the ground line, knees drawn up, axe held across the body
apex: highest point, knees tucked toward the chest, axe raised, body compact
falling: legs extending downward again, axe lowering, body dropping toward the ground line
landing: feet back on the ground line, knees deeply bent absorbing the impact, axe low

actions.label: Block High
actions.note: Feet stay planted in the same place in every frame. The blocking pose is held from frame 3 onward.
poses: guard stance, starting to raise the axe shaft with both hands
the axe shaft raised horizontally in front of the face and upper body, elbows tucked in, head lowered behind it
block held: axe shaft across chest and face height, body braced, knees bent, sparks flaring where the blade tilts up
block held, identical to frame 3 with a very slight extra brace (shoulders 1 pixel lower)

actions.label: Block Low
actions.note: Feet stay on the same ground line; the body is crouched. The blocking pose is held from frame 3 onward.
poses: guard stance, starting to crouch and lower the axe
crouching, knees bending, axe head lowering in front of the legs
block held: low crouch, axe held vertically in front of the shins with the blade down, torso leaning forward behind it
block held, identical to frame 3 with a very slight extra brace

actions.label: Hit High
actions.note: Being struck in the face/upper body from the LEFT: the reaction pushes the character back to the RIGHT. Feet stay near the ground line, one foot may slide.
poses: moment of impact: head snaps back, eyes squeezed shut in pain, torso jerks back a few pixels, axe swings loosely
maximum recoil: torso leaning well back, head thrown back, one foot sliding, arms pushed back
recovering: torso leaning back less, grimacing, weight returning to the front foot
almost recovered: back near the guard stance with a pained face

actions.label: Light Attack
actions.note: A fast horizontal axe slash toward the LEFT at chest height. The strike frames are 3 and 4.
poses: guard stance, weight shifting back, hands tightening on the shaft
wind-up: the axe pulled back to the right side of the body, torso twisted away from the target
strike begins: torso twisting forward, the axe swinging forward at chest height, arms extending
full extension: the axe fully extended forward to the left at chest height, blade leading, small electric arc trailing behind it
follow-through: the axe swung past the target, body leaning into the swing, back foot on its toes
recovery: pulling the axe back toward the body, returning to the guard stance

actions.label: Heavy Chop
actions.note: A slow, powerful overhead chop toward the LEFT. The strike frames are 4 and 5.
poses: guard stance, weight sinking onto the back leg, starting to lift the axe up and back
axe raised high overhead in both hands, body leaning back, knees bent, sparks gathering on the blades
apex of the wind-up: maximum coil, back arched, teeth bared, sparks crackling
chopping down: body lunging forward to the left, the axe descending diagonally in front, motion arc of sparks behind the blade
impact: the axe blade at waist height in front, body in a deep lunge, a burst of electric sparks at the blade
recovery: rising and pulling the axe back toward the guard stance

actions.label: Storm Charge
actions.note: The character powers up in place; feet stay planted. The electric sparks grow from faint to intense.
poses: guard stance, gripping the axe with both hands, a few sparks on the blade
lowering into a wide stance, pulling the axe back beside the body, sparks gathering along the blades
body coiled, muscles tense, teeth bared, electric arcs crackling along the whole axe
peak charge: roaring, lightning arcing around the axe and the arms, the axe head glowing bright yellow-white

actions.label: Storm Whirlwind
actions.note: A three-hit spinning axe combo toward the RIGHT (the way he faces). The strike frames are 3, 5 and 7; frames 4, 6 and 8 are transition frames between hits. Lightning trails follow the axe.
poses: wind-up: deep crouch, the axe pulled far back behind the body, intense sparks on the blades
lunging forward to the right, body turning, the axe starting to swing
first hit: a wide horizontal sweep, the axe fully extended forward at chest height, a bright lightning arc trailing behind it
transition: body rotating, the axe pulled back across the body, crouched, sparks trailing
second hit: a reverse spinning sweep, the axe fully extended forward at chest height, torso twisted, lightning arc trailing
transition: rising up, the axe lifted high overhead in both hands, body stretched tall
third hit, the finisher: a huge overhead slam, the axe blade driving down in front of the body, a large lightning burst at the impact point
follow-through: the axe buried low at the ground in front, body bowed, sparks fading
recovery: standing back up, pulling the axe back to the guard stance

actions.label: Knockdown
actions.note: The character is hit from the RIGHT (the side he faces) and falls backward to the LEFT, ending lying on his back with his head to the left and his feet to the right. The final frames are a held lying pose. The lying body must still fit inside its cell.
poses: hit reaction: head snaps back, torso jerks back, axe swinging loosely in one hand
airborne: leaning back at about 45 degrees, both feet off the ground, arms flung wide, axe dropping
falling: body nearly horizontal in the air, legs kicked up, axe tumbling beside him
hitting the ground on his back, impact, body slightly bent, dust puff
lying flat on his back, limp, head to the left, feet to the right, the axe on the ground beside him
lying flat, identical to frame 5 (held pose)
